fields.label: Database Type
fields.help: The database type that the Metastore service stores its data.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Deletion Protection
fields.help: Indicates if the dataproc metastore should be protected against accidental deletions.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The location where the metastore service should reside.

fields.label: Network
fields.help: The relative resource name of the VPC network on which the instance can be accessed.

fields.label: Port
fields.help: The TCP port at which the metastore service is reached.

fields.label: Release Channel
fields.help: The release channel of the service.

fields.label: Service ID
fields.help: The ID of the metastore service.

fields.label: Tier
fields.help: The tier of the service.

fields.label: Encryption Config
KMS Key
fields.help: The fully qualified customer provided Cloud KMS key name to use for customer data encryption.
Information used to configure the Dataproc Metastore service to encrypt customer data at rest.

fields.label: Hive Metastore Config
Endpoint Protocol
fields.help: The protocol to use for the metastore service endpoint.

fields.label: Version
fields.help: The Hive metastore schema version.

fields.label: Auxiliary Versions
Version
fields.help: The Hive metastore version of the auxiliary service.
A mapping of Hive metastore version to the auxiliary version configuration.

fields.label: Kerberos Config
Krb5 Config Gcs Uri
fields.help: A Cloud Storage URI that specifies the path to a krb5.conf file.

fields.label: Principal
fields.help: A Kerberos principal that exists in the both the keytab the KDC to authenticate as.

fields.label: Keytab
Cloud Secret
fields.help: The relative resource name of a Secret Manager secret version, in the following form: "projects/{projectNumber}/secrets/{secret_id}/versions/{version_id}".
A Kerberos keytab file that can be used to authenticate a service principal with a Kerberos Key Distribution Center (KDC).
Information used to configure the Hive metastore service as a service principal in a Kerberos realm.
Configuration information specific to running Hive metastore software as the metastore service.

fields.label: Maintenance Window
Day Of Week
fields.help: The day of week, when the window starts.

fields.label: Hour Of Day
fields.help: The hour of day (0-23) when the window starts.
The one hour maintenance window of the metastore service.

fields.label: Metadata Integration
Data Catalog Config
Enabled
fields.help: Defines whether the metastore metadata should be synced to Data Catalog.
The integration config for the Data Catalog service.
The setting that defines how metastore metadata should be integrated with external services and systems.

fields.label: Network Config
Consumers
Subnetwork
fields.help: The subnetwork of the customer project from which an IP address is reserved and used as the Dataproc Metastore service's endpoint.
The consumer-side network configuration for the Dataproc Metastore instance.
The configuration specifying the network settings for the Dataproc Metastore service.

fields.label: Scaling Config
Instance Size
fields.help: Metastore instance sizes.

fields.label: Scaling Factor
fields.help: Scaling factor, in increments of 0.1 for values less than 1.0, and increments of 1.0 for values greater than 1.0.

fields.label: Autoscaling Config
Autoscaling Enabled
fields.help: Defines whether autoscaling is enabled.

fields.label: Limit Config
Max Scaling Factor
fields.help: The maximum scaling factor that the service will autoscale to.

fields.label: Min Scaling Factor
fields.help: The minimum scaling factor that the service will autoscale to.
Represents the limit configuration of a metastore service.
Represents the autoscaling configuration of a metastore service.
Represents the scaling configuration of a metastore service.

fields.label: Scheduled Backup
Backup Location
fields.help: A Cloud Storage URI of a folder, in the format gs://<bucket_name>/<path_inside_bucket>.

fields.label: Cron Schedule
fields.help: The scheduled interval in Cron format, see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cron The default is empty: scheduled backup is not enabled.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.help: Defines whether the scheduled backup is enabled.

fields.label: Time Zone
fields.help: Specifies the time zone to be used when interpreting cronSchedule.
The configuration of scheduled backup for the metastore service.

fields.label: Telemetry Config
Log Format
fields.help: The output format of the Dataproc Metastore service's logs.
The configuration specifying telemetry settings for the Dataproc Metastore service.
